test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Politics and money g__o together__ in this country.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e **"****go hand in hand".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Go hand in hand" **is **an idiomatic expression** that means** two things are closely related or work together very well**, which aligns with the idea that politics and money are interconnected in this country.
 
• This phrase effectively conveys the notion that the two concepts described (politics and money) are interdependent or commonly found together, which is the intended meaning in the sentence.

Therefore, the best fit for substitution is- Politics and money ***go hand in together__ ***in this country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Go arm in arm** (Option 1) and **go holding hands** (Option 2) are phrases that can denote closeness or partnership but are more often used to describe physical closeness between people rather than metaphorical or conceptual relationships like that between politics and money.
